dedupe_keys.name: real world dataset collection for drive by and direct monitoring of railway bridges

description: Maximilian Michael Rupp and a multi-institution team publish synchronised measurements from five steel railway bridges and the trains crossing them. The collection combines direct bridge monitoring, drive-by observations from ICE 4, ICE TD and ICE L trains, and forced-vibration shaker tests. Train speeds range from 5 to 200 kilometres per hour. Bridge spans range from 9 to 77.5 metres, with construction dates from 1911 to 2004. The August 2026 Zenodo release lists a data archive, README and organisation diagram, free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. These observations support validation of vehicle-bridge dynamic simulations and monitoring methods under resonance and non-resonance conditions. Exact geographic locations, measurement dates and sampling rates remain unknown from the landing page. The unified file structure is described in the accompanying README, which was not downloaded. No related catalogue resource is explicitly identified.
